name: get-all-people
description: Retrieve a list of all people from the system. Returns all people the authenticated user has permission to view. Future support for pagination and filtering will be added. Requires authentication with a valid JWT token.

page.description: Page number for pagination (future support, currently not implemented)

limit.description: Number of results per page (future support, currently not implemented, max 100)

filter.description: Text filter for searching people (future support, currently not implemented)

text.description: JSON string containing success status and array of people data
